summary: Verified OwnModuleGrid refactor: shared component renders identically on /u/owner (variant='own-module') and /profile (variant='quick-access'). All data-testids preserved, tile counts match (18 = 16 base + Admin + Owner Center; Ambassador skipped because is_ambassador=false). Backend endpoints expose required fields. No visual or functional regression detected.

integration_issues.issue: On first attempt URL stayed on /u/owner after click — likely a click race with the 'Welcome back' / 'First Look' onboarding modal overlay (pre-existing modal, NOT introduced by this refactor). quick-owner-center on /profile uses identical handler logic and PASSED, confirming the testid + path are correct.

critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean: 126-line shared component at /app/frontend/src/components/profile/OwnModuleGrid.jsx; both pages import it without leftover unused icon imports (verified via grep — Wallet/Trophy remaining usages in ProfilePage.js are within plain string text or actual JSX usage in 'Score & rank' tile body, both legitimate).
Tile-count math: with role=super_admin and is_ambassador=false, expected = 16 base + Admin + Owner Center = 18 tools. Verified header reads '18 tools' on /u/owner.

Slugify routes 'Become Ambassador' → 'become-ambassador' (NOT 'ambassador'). The review_request mentioned data-testid='module-ambassador' for the Ambassador tile, but the actual implementation produces 'module-become-ambassador'. Only 'Ambassador' (post-approval, label='Ambassador') would produce 'module-ambassador'. This is consistent with both pre/post refactor behaviour — flagging only so the main agent and downstream test-writers know the slug pattern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: OwnModuleGrid is now the single source of truth for own-profile module tile grid. data-testids: variant='own-module' uses 'own-module-grid' wrapper + 'module-<slug>' per tile; variant='quick-access' uses 'quick-access-grid-wrap' + 'quick-access-grid' inner + 'quick-<slug>'. Slugs are lowercased label with spaces→dashes. Ambassador apply tile = 'become-ambassador' slug. /profile/:userId redirect was not directly testable with available accounts (only owner has a known username), but the logic in ProfilePage.js lines 48-58 was NOT touched by the refactor.
